title: server.stop (platform → host)
description: Disruptive: refused with match_in_progress when Ready Up says update_safe=false, unless force. csm sends `quit` to the console, waits grace_s, then kills the tmux session. Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id). Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock (a command replayed long after it was sent is not run).
